outcome: level of satisfaction with maternity care during labour and birth
willingness to recommend the facility to others
cohort: A random sample of 300 women aged 18-45 years in the postnatal ward of a referral hospital in north-eastern Namibia.
finding: Almost all women (98%) were satisfied with the maternity care services and were highly likely to recommend the facility to others, with satisfaction significantly influenced by respect for women's choices, culture, privacy, and provider attitude.
mod_finding: No association was found between the level of overall satisfaction with care and the mode of birth.
